FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 306
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Wes Kitchens
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/15/2025
Senate Bill 306 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of: (1) county and
municipal agencies, boards, commissions, and certain public employees and officials to publish
discretionary funds and expenditures on an official website on a monthly basis; (2) the
Administrative Office of Courts and the Office of Prosecution Services, to post the discretionary
funds and expenditures of clerks and judges and district attorneys without an official website;
and (3) the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts to establish rules for the publishing of
discretionary funds and expenditures.
